aliases: 点标题展开的那种列表

description.zh: 由多个可折叠区块组成的垂直列表：点击标题展开内容、再点收起，可互斥（同时只开一项） 也可多开。用于在有限空间里收纳成组内容，让用户按需展开。
description.en: A vertical list of collapsible sections: clicking a header expands its content and clicking again collapses it, either exclusively (one open at a time) or independently. Packs grouped content into limited space for on-demand expansion.

use_when.zh: 设置页分组长表单（高级选项默认收起）
use_when.en: Long settings forms with advanced sections collapsed

use_when.zh: 移动端长内容分期呈现
use_when.en: Progressive disclosure of long content on mobile

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要同时对照多块内容
avoid_when.en: Users must compare sections side by side

avoid_when.zh: 核心内容应默认可见（收起会藏关键信息）
avoid_when.en: Essential content should be visible by default

avoid_when.zh: 打印或 SEO 需要全量文本（需处理展开态）
avoid_when.en: Print or SEO needs full text — handle the expanded state

note.zh: 同时只展开一项，最常见
note.en: One open at a time, the common default

note.zh: 每项带边框或分隔线，区块感更强
note.en: Per-item borders or dividers for stronger grouping

notes.zh: 展开动画：grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr 过渡（或测量 scrollHeight 设 max-height）， 箭头 rotate 180° 同步旋转。标题用 button，Enter/Space 触发；aria-expanded + aria-controls 关联面板。互斥逻辑放在受控 state 里处理；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 时可去掉高度动画。
notes.en: Expand animation: transition grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr (or measure scrollHeight into max-height); rotate the chevron 180° in sync. Headers are buttons triggered by Enter/Space; link panels with aria-expanded + aria-controls. Keep the exclusive logic in controlled state; drop the height animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个手风琴（Accordion）组件：多个折叠区块，点击标题展开收起，支持单开与多开两种模式。
basic.en: Create an Accordion component: collapsible sections with click-to-toggle headers, supporting single-open and multiple-open modes.

design.zh: 创建 Accordion 组件。要求：每项标题行左侧标题、右侧箭头（展开时旋转 180°）； 展开收起用高度过渡动画（200ms 左右）；分隔线或卡片式两种外观； 当前项标题可加强调色；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create an Accordion. Requirements: header rows with the title on the left and a chevron on the right (rotating 180° when open); smooth height transition (~200ms); divider or card looks; optional accent tint on the open header; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Accordion：items + openIds 受控 state，单开模式 setOpenId(id)； 面板用 grid grid-rows-[0fr]/[1fr] + transition-[grid-template-rows] 实现高度动画 （时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)），内层 overflow-hidden；箭头 -rotate-90/rotate-0 过渡； 标题 button + aria-expanded + aria-controls；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Accordion: items + openIds controlled state, single-open maps to setOpenId(id); panels animate height via grid grid-rows-[0fr]/[1fr] + transition-[grid-template-rows] (duration scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)) with an inner overflow-hidden; chevron transitions -rotate-90/rotate-0; headers are buttons with aria-expanded + aria-controls; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现手风琴（Accordion）组件。

先检查现有组件体系与 Design Token，优先复用现有的表面色与圆角变量。
用途：FAQ 与设置页分组。
要求：
- 支持单开（互斥）与多开两种模式
- 高度展开动画，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 键盘可用：button 标题 + aria-expanded/aria-controls
- 深浅色主题一致，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement an Accordion component in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing
surface and radius variables.
Usage: FAQs and grouped settings.
Requirements:
- Single-open (exclusive) and multiple-open modes
- Height expand animation, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
- Keyboard accessible: button headers + aria-expanded/aria-controls
- Consistent light/dark themes, no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 展开与收起不同分组，比较单项和多项展开的阅读节奏。
task.en: Expand different sections and compare the reading flow.

checks.zh: 标题应始终可见，折叠不能让用户失去位置。
checks.en: Keep headings visible when details collapse.

checks.zh: 展开状态通过 aria-expanded 表达，按钮保留焦点。
checks.en: Expose expansion with aria-expanded and retain button focus.
